description:
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Visionary Augmenter.
Visionary Augmenter enters the battlefield triggering its Fabricate ability, choosing to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Visionary Augmenter, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Servo token, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Servo token, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.
